The '''Dimensional Star''', added in [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log#Update_8_-_JoJo's_Bizarre_Adventure_+_Christmas_Update_Part_1 Update 8], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (3rd Season). This item will become '''unobtainable''' as of Update 10.
